examples.text: To have evil designs.

glosses: The shape or appearance given to an object, especially one that is intended to make it more attractive.

examples.text: He turned back to the scene before him and the enormous new block of council dwellings. The design was some way after Corbusier but the block was built up on plinths and resembled an Atlantic liner swimming diagonally across the site.

glosses: The art of designing

examples.text: Danish furniture design is world-famous.

glosses: To plan and carry out (a picture, work of art, construction etc.).

examples.text: He always designs gaming laptops from 4:00 pm to 1:00 am.

She designed his retirement from the Royal Irish Artillery, and had negociated an immediate berth for him on the Staff of the Commander of the Forces, and a prospective one in the household of Lord Townshend […]

glosses: To plan (to do something).

examples.text: The king designed to mount an expedition to the New World.

glosses: To assign, appoint (something to someone); to designate.

examples.text: he looks not below the Moon, but hath designed the regiment of sublunary affairs unto inferiour deputations.
He was designed to the study of the law.

glosses: To mark out and exhibit; to designate; to indicate; to show; to point out; to appoint.

examples.text: We shall see / Justice design the victor's chivalry.
